changelog:
office-floor-tour v0.1.1

- Added detailed SKILL.md documentation covering workflow, shot list planning, input requirements, billing, recovery, and safe update procedures.
- Clarifies routing for non-office floor stills and specific cases like empty floor names.
- Explains how to interact with Beatra services using the bundled MCP client.
- Outlines error handling, client operation, and update policies.
- No changes to code or processing logic announced in this version.
summary: Turn seller-supplied office floor stills into one office floor tour clip per labeled still. This office floor video studio lays out each floor walkthrough clip from the seller-supplied floor photo, then delivers an office listing clip and a floor walkthrough video as separate files. Use it for office floor packs that give each still its own clip.
